heading: Persistence and global-heading mobility respond differently to enlargement.
supporting_panels: S4/S5 geometry and mobility, S12 cadence checks, and the same f = 0.05 small/large native comparisons. At that input, global-heading-derived physical-mobility ratios are 1.845,3.606 and 6.356 in Wave-pinning, Holmes and Spring, each withCI above 1, alongside persistence ratios above 1.
weaknesses: The global-heading conversion is not one tracked site diffusivity. Short-lag slopes are cadence-sensitive; Wave-pinning direct excess-persistence CI includes the geometric reference, so the two source estimands cannot be collapsed into a strict common geometric claim.
further_runs: Save finer scalar output and test converged short-lag slopes at the same fixed inputs; extend qualified single-region tracks to compare literal site MSD with the heading-derived proxy. No new integrations are included in this delivery.
